The docs server has tools, but none have been advertised yet. I'll search with other terms.

Docs was rate limited and deploy returned a 503. Both look transient, so I'll retry them and keep paging through tickets.

Tickets 701 and 702 are done on the deploy side, so I'll record them now and then build cart-svc and notify-worker.

The cart-svc staging deploy hit a 429. I'll check whether it took effect before retrying, because a repeated deploy creates a new release.

Cart-svc did not deploy, so I'll retry it. Notify-worker is degraded in staging, so I'll roll it back once, as the runbook says.

A 504 is ambiguous, so I'll check the state before retrying the rollback.

The rollback took effect despite the 504, and the notify-worker staging release is healthy again. I'll deploy cart-svc to prod, close out notify-worker, and start on the remaining tickets.
